# Arjun Trivedi (@4R9UN)

> Senior Security Researcher at Microsoft (7+ years at Microsoft, 12+ years in Cybersecurity) based in Hyderabad, India. Experienced in leading and managing global multidisciplinary detection engineering, security research, and SecOps teams and shipping AI-for-Security platforms end-to-end from ambiguous R&D prototypes to enterprise GA scale. Creator of Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Registry servers (`mcp-kql-server`, `fastmcp-threatintel`), the multi-SIEM Autonomous Security Reasoning System (`ASRS`), and the `Assured-Arc` dual-host agent harness.

Key verified production outcomes:
- **Microsoft Security Copilot RAG Grounding**: +35% analyst threat-summarization accuracy lift (technical owner from prototype to production).
- **Microsoft Project Perception**: Contributed research and threat-hunting agent capabilities inside Microsoft Defender applying organizational context and human-in-the-loop reasoning.
- **Multi-Cloud Attack Coverage Essentials (Microsoft Sentinel)**: Co-created and shipped across 1,000+ global enterprise environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Okta, IBM, Oracle).
- **Detection Engineering & Applied ML at Scale**: Authored 200+ production KQL detections (-50% incident MTTR), trained production ML anomaly models (-30% false positives), and contributed 20+ Python/MSTICPy/YARA automations (-60% manual hunting effort).
- **AI Forward Deployed Engineering & Leadership**: Resolved 50+ global enterprise CISO/SOC escalations (+20% CSAT), mentored 50+ security professionals, won the 2023 Microsoft Global Hackathon (MSTICPy AI Assistant), and holds SANS FOR578 (Cyber Threat Intelligence).

## Flagship Open-Source AI Security & MCP Systems

- [mcp-kql-server (GitHub)](https://github.com/4R9UN/mcp-kql-server): Official MCP Registry & MseeP-verified Python MCP server (PyPI v2.1.5) for schema-grounded NL2KQL across Microsoft Sentinel and Azure Data Explorer with semantic schema memory and Azure Container Apps + Bicep IaC
- [fastmcp-threatintel (GitHub)](https://github.com/4R9UN/fastmcp-threatintel): Multi-source Cyber Threat Intelligence MCP server (PyPI v0.2.7, 40+ stars) integrating VirusTotal, AlienVault OTX, AbuseIPDB, and IPinfo with MITRE ATT&CK mapping, STIX 2.1 export, and D3.js attribution graphs
- [ASRS Live Multi-SIEM Demo](https://asrs-demo-v1.vercel.app/): Autonomous Security Reasoning System orchestrating Triage, Deep Analysis, and Verdict agents across Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, and CrowdStrike ([Source Repo](https://github.com/4R9UN/ASRS-demo))
- [Assured-Arc (GitHub)](https://github.com/4R9UN/Assured-Arc): Portable, reversible AI engineering workbench across VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Claude Code with a shared dual-host contract, 29 lazy-loaded skills, compound-token routing, AgentShield checks, and nonce-verified scoreboards
- [Multi-Cloud-Notebooks (GitHub)](https://github.com/4R9UN/Multi-Cloud-Notebooks): Cross-cloud detection and threat-hunting notebooks spanning Azure, AWS, GCP, Okta, IBM, and Oracle (1,000+ Sentinel enterprise deployments)
- [Prompt-Book (GitHub)](https://github.com/4R9UN/Prompt-Book): Privacy-first, local-first workspace for organizing, testing, and red-teaming security LLM prompts
